summary: Iteration 20: Code quality fixes testing complete. httpOnly cookie-based authentication migration verified working. All 13 backend tests passed. Frontend login, dashboard, inventory, clients, quotes, leads pages all load correctly with cookie auth. Logout clears session properly.

critical_code_review_comments: httpOnly cookie auth migration verified working:
1. Backend login sets httpOnly cookie with correct attributes (path=/api, secure=true, samesite=lax, max_age=86400)
2. Backend get_current_user checks cookie if no Authorization header
4. Frontend no longer uses localStorage for auth tokens
5. All protected routes (dashboard, inventory, clients, quotes) work with cookie auth
6. Logout endpoint properly deletes the auth_token cookie
